find verb

also discover, come across, locate, find the place of

classical

inveniō, invenīre, invēnī, inventum

verb, fourth conjugation · Conjugation on Wiktionary

Other words

  • reperiō, reperīre, repperī, repertum — find (by searching), discover

    verb, fourth conjugation · also used · classical · Varro RR 1.2.9: quod nūllus in ejus fundō reperīrī poterat stolō; Traupman 315 · Conjugation on Wiktionary

    Lewis & Short: “to find, meet with, find out, either by searching or by accident”.

Examples

  • Invēnistī.

    You found it.composed
